verdict.rationale: Ultrametric is a process service that runs no model, so publishing an official MCP server applies. It documents a hosted remote MCP server at https://api.ultrametric.ai/mcp with connection steps, auth scopes (e.g. `context:protected:read`), and a `status` tool. A hands-on probe confirms the endpoint is live and returns a standards-compliant 401 with RFC 9728 OAuth protected-resource metadata, which is an expected sign-in wall rather than a failure. Missing for 10: no observed authenticated session (successful `initialize`/`tools/list`) or full documented MCP tool catalog. [2026-10-08 adversarial bias audit (owner-product bring-up lane): quality capped 9 -> 7 and confidence high -> medium — MCP cells are the most bias-sensitive class (fleet precedent: probe-grade evidence); the recorded probe shows only the documented AUTH_REQUIRED wall, and the rationale concedes no observed initialize/tools/list session. full stands on the documented hosted server, documented tools, and the live RFC 9728 wall; a never-observed handshake cannot carry q9 high. Ultrametric-affiliation governance, README §9.]
